title: Linear Equation Solver
description: 2 captured saves. One original BASIC player; historical bugs remain.
versionOrder: Within each capture, save order is retained. Cross-capture ordering is a presentation guess; tape numbers do not establish development dates. Similarity clusters are provisional, and collected saves are not necessarily revisions of one program.

versions.label: LINEAR EQUATION SOLVER
versions.note: validated payload; runtime untested. Ordered lines, consistent pointers, exact-length zero end; exact left/right timing match; runtime untested
versions.unavailableReason: Another recovered save; the site offers one selected player.
versions.startupSource:
1 '
100 INPUT"WHAT ORDER";D
110 DIMA(D,D+1)
115 DIMB(D+1)
120 FORX=1TOD:FORY=1TOD+1
130 PRINT"WHAT IS A("X","Y")";:INPUTA$:IFA$="H"THEN4000ELSEA(X,Y)=VAL(A$)
140 NEXT
160 NEXT
170 FORR=1TOD
180 GOSUB3000:PRINT
200 F=1/A(R,R):RX=R:GOSUB1000
210 FORB=1TOD+1:P(B)=A(R,B):NEXT
